info.title: REAP Admin API
info.description:
Internal admin API contract for `reap-admin-ui` and `admin-api-server`.

This surface is intentionally separate from public APIs and is the canonical
contract for privileged internal operations.

## Security posture
- Accept only internal admin JWTs (distinct audience/issuer from customer tokens).
- Enforce role-based authorization for every operation.
- All write operations require reason/ticket metadata and must emit immutable audit events.

## Baseline roles
- `admin.readonly`: read-only access.
- `admin.ops`: operational actions (role-gated write operations).
- `admin.super`: tenant-impacting or high-risk actions.

Supported search dimensions:
- `id`

Use `searchField=auto` (default) for best-effort matching across all supported dimensions.

get.description:
Resolves one of `runId`, `workflowId`, or `threadId` into a normalized
trace response using existing DB_CORE/Postgres records. In Phase 1 this
endpoint is composed directly by admin-api-server using the same
read-only Postgres store pattern as RAG observability, not by proxying
through inventory-service. The response reports wall time from
`created_at` to `completedAt`; precise queue and execution timing remain
optional until `startedAt` is persisted.

Forces an immediate connector runtime sync from Fleet through

get.description:
Returns compact connector VM runtime health for otel-agent,
command-agent, and connector VPN. The response includes live chart
series from Prometheus Infra plus Grafana dashboard and embed links.
By default the response is scoped to all reporting connectors in the
organization. When connector VM metrics expose `connector_id`, callers
may pass `connectorId` to scope the same native health panels and
Grafana links to one connector. The connector selector payload includes
connector names when they are available.

AdminBearerAuth.description:
Internal admin JWT only. Tokens must carry an admin audience/issuer and role claims.
The token issuer is expected to be the internal auth service backed by Google Workspace SSO.
Servers should enforce allowed email domain and required admin group membership claims.
